meta_description: Turner Garden Maintenance in Birmingham offers professional garden care, landscaping, and seasonal maintenance. Local, reliable service. Call 07375 368022.
hero_eyebrow: Local Gardener — 15+ Years Transforming Birmingham Gardens
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to regular maintenance, Turner Garden Maintenance keeps your outdoor space looking its best, season after season.
services_subhead: Whether you need weekly lawn cuts, seasonal planting, or a full garden redesign, we handle every job with care and expertise.

services.title: Regular Lawn Care & Grass Cutting
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly grass cutting tailored to the season. We keep your lawn healthy, neatly edged, and looking its best year-round.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Pruning
services.desc: Expert hedge and shrub trimming that shapes your garden and promotes healthy growth. We tidy overgrown borders and maintain formal hedges to specification.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Clear away dead growth, fallen leaves, and garden debris. We leave your garden neat and ready for replanting or maintenance work.

services.title: Flower Bed Planting & Seasonal Displays
services.desc: Bespoke planting design and installation for spring bulbs, summer colour, and winter interest. We choose varieties suited to your soil and sunlight.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Transform unused space into a beautiful, functional garden. We advise on layout, hard landscaping, planting schemes, and bespoke features.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Removal
services.desc: Safe felling, crown reduction, and stump removal. We handle large or awkward trees and dispose of wood responsibly.

about_pullquote: I started this work because a tidy garden changes how you feel at home.
about_para_1: Turner Garden Maintenance was established over 15 years ago in Rednal, serving Birmingham and the surrounding areas. What started as a passion for creating beautiful outdoor spaces has grown into a trusted local business, built on reliable service and genuine care for every garden we work on.
about_para_2: Our customers keep us coming back because we listen to what they want, turn up on time, and always leave the garden cleaner than we found it. We're not the cheapest, but we're honest about costs and deliver real value—whether that's fortnightly lawn cuts or a complete garden refresh. Many of our clients have been with us for over a decade.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Gardeners Say About Turner

reviews.text: Been using Turner for nearly 5 years now. Never miss a week, always on time, and the garden looks immaculate. Fair pricing and a proper friendly bloke. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the back garden completely redesigned last spring. The whole process was smooth from start to finish. Derek gave really good advice on the planting and it's flourished. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Linda M.

reviews.text: Called Turner after years of letting the garden get out of hand. Instead of laughing at the state of it, he gave us a clear plan to get it back. Two months in and it's transformed. Great service.
reviews.author: Paul W.
